title: Zephyrine and the Visitor
author: X. M. Villalobos
blurb: Lena Vane, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
